decisions.reason: The yogurt on mango mousse won a public health award and sits close to the core yogurt range, so the visible success and low cost of continuing favor keeping it.
Featured on the home page as the new flagship Abendbrotkäse, this cheese carries strong public commitment and is central to the announced cheese direction, so management will persist with it.
The semi-hard cheese wheel stays close to the established offer and needs little extra investment, so any weak results can be treated as normal ramp-up rather than failure.
As a line with several variants, the spicy cheese represents sizable invested resources and assortment commitment, which makes withdrawal unlikely so soon after launch.
The mild soft cheese was publicly announced as rounding off the new cheese offer, and this visible commitment argues for giving it more time.
The washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche item and least visibly promoted, but it belongs to the newly launched cheese assortment, so management will likely keep it for now.
